prompt: Review Prosus's indirect and direct causal relationship to digital attention, gaming and consumer ecosystems.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Prosus receives most look-through value from Tencent's games and attention ecosystem and additional value from ecommerce platforms; the benefit reaches PRX holders through NAV, private-asset cash flow and discounted-share repurchases.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject if ecosystem exposure is immaterial after debt and discount, Tencent or private-platform economics deteriorate, or governance and capital allocation prevent operating value from reaching PRX shareholders.
